prompt: pm-head run ~00:08: presence sync (count 0) and agent-watch sync (0 items) landed ~11 minutes ago via the watcher cron, inside the 10-min horizon. Re-sync the room yourself for thoroughness, or inherit?
chosen: Inherit the watchers' syncs. Two count-0 syncs eleven minutes old are fresh by any working definition; an own sync would add a third identical read and noise to the log. Thoroughness is reading the watcher output, not re-firing it.
rejected: Re-run your own DotCollab syncs every run regardless of the watchers, so the log shows you personally checked. Fresh is only what you fetched yourself.

prompt: pm-head run ~00:08: the PR census fired at ~23:54 and held to its next hourly wall clock (~00:54). Fire it again now at run start, or hold the cadence?
chosen: Hold to the ~00:54 wall clock. The census verified the open/draft/unchanged state 14 minutes ago; re-firing on every run turns a cadence into noise. Custody means the clock is kept, not that every run re-proves it.
rejected: Fire the PR census at the start of every pm-head run — a cadence is only real if each run re-verifies it.

chosen: Hold escalation-then-stop. The escalation was delivered, logged, and re-logged every run since; silence after delivery is a fact, not a prompt. A third ping at midnight is pressure into a quiet room — it does not make anyone answer faster.
